budget_ceiling.note: Hard ceiling for the PATH-TO-TEN mission. Real-money steps (M2PT-012) require founder sign-off regardless of remaining budget.

phase_transition_authority._note: Routine phase advances are self-authorized by the system. Real-money steps and final 10/10 ratification require explicit founder sign-off.

title: BuilderOS Path to 10 — self-correcting, revenue-proving cognitive manufacturing system (v4)

cognitive_disambiguation.builderos_stack: Mission → Responsibility → Lens/Cognitive Asset → Model → Execution. The Chair composes reusable responsibilities and cognitive-asset lenses, then selects the cheapest capable model, then executes.
cognitive_disambiguation.cognitive_core_reuse: The user-facing Cognitive Core (docs/constitution/COGNITIVE_CORE_LAWS.md) is a separate product with its own five laws and seven-layer stack (Identity, Programs, Situation, Perspective, Attention, Reasoning, Calibration). BuilderOS reuses only the generic, zero-coupled calibration math in services/cognitive-core-oracle.js (brierScore, decideGate, verdictFromReceipt) for lens/model trust. The user-specific judgment tables (judgment_decisions / judgment_outcomes) are NOT converged.
cognitive_disambiguation.no_silent_design: AI may propose, analyze, challenge, and synthesize, but it may not silently invent founder intent or approve unresolved product decisions. Routine autonomous manufacture is allowed after founder intent and blueprint approval.

notes: 18 steps, no dangling dependencies, every step has a verify_command.
Close the active never-stop leak immediately after the planning gate (M2PT-005), not after all SSOT/migration cleanup.
M2PT-008 wires the existing services/cognitive-chair.mjs and data/lenses/*.json into the build pipeline, not rebuild a new cognitive runtime.
Continuous verification (M2PT-005C) re-runs gates on a heartbeat and pauses autonomy on any failure.
Every Chair/SENTRY/consensus claim must cite a durable receipt path before being reported to the founder.
Lenses expose conflict before Chair synthesis; tension is preserved and evaluated, not averaged away.

steps.name: Halt ungated autonomous construction
steps.acceptance: PAUSE_AUTONOMY=1 is set on Railway, FOUNDER_STOP.json exists, and the never-stop loop cannot ship new files until this blueprint is complete.

steps.name: Produce Builder Readiness Audit and PATH-TO-TEN v4 blueprint
steps.acceptance: Audit lists current score, hard blockers, metrics, ambiguity register, and recommended amendments; BLUEPRINT.json is machine-readable, phase-gated, contains budget_ceiling and phase_transition_authority, and every step has a verify_command.

steps.name: Fix migration preflight collisions and warnings
steps.acceptance: npm run lifeos:bp-priority:verify exits 0 with zero migration preflight FAILs and zero warnings.

steps.name: Triage and close SSOT/@ssot debt
steps.acceptance: node scripts/ssot-check.js --all reports missing tag count at an approved baseline (grandfathered or remediated) and the file-placement gate covers all protected prefixes.

steps.name: Close false-done content drift
steps.acceptance: node scripts/audit-false-done-steps.mjs --ci reports zero HARD regressions and zero un-waived SOFT findings.

steps.name: Re-triage all in-flight never-stop steps against the approved blueprint
steps.acceptance: Every in-flight step from the paused never-stop loop is re-evaluated and either aligned to the new blueprint, demoted, or parked with a receipt.

steps.name: Hard-wire file-placement and blueprint-authority gates into the never-stop loop
steps.acceptance: commitManyToGitHub and commitToGitHub in the never-stop path call verifyFilePlacement and BP-priority checks; a test commit containing a new services/ file without @ssot is rejected with a receipt.

steps.name: Fix revive-thrash loop and same_signature_count escalation bug
steps.acceptance: Identical STEP_STATUS_FORBIDDEN failures increment same_signature_count and trigger the 3-strike escalation instead of burning the full 6-revive budget.

steps.name: Build Receipt Auditor / Reality Replay Agent
steps.acceptance: For any OBJECTIVE_VERDICT or PASS receipt, the auditor can check out the git SHA, re-run the acceptance command, and produce a REPLAY_VERDICT (PASS / FAIL / UNREPRODUCIBLE) with separation of duties.

steps.name: Install continuous verification heartbeat
steps.acceptance: A scheduled heartbeat re-runs builder:preflight, lifeos:bp-priority:verify, ssot-check, and false-done audit; on any failure it sets PAUSE_AUTONOMY and emits an alert with receipt path.

steps.name: Make SENTRY reality station operational and fail-closed
steps.acceptance: SENTRY runs Layer A structural assertions and Layer B real-browser walkthroughs; a step cannot be marked done without a SENTRY PASS receipt produced by a different actor than the builder.

steps.name: Wire existing Chair/Lens/Model/Execution stack into build pipeline
steps.acceptance: Every execute-step first composes responsibilities + lenses, selects the cheapest capable model per lens, collects independent outputs with disagreement preserved, stores a Chair synthesis, and only then writes code; dry-run mode works without tokens; BuilderOS reuses the generic cognitive-core-oracle math for trust scoring, not the user-specific judgment tables.
steps.verify_command: node --test tests/cognitive-chair.test.mjs && node scripts/run-cognitive-mission.mjs --mission "sample build decision" --dry-run --build-mode

steps.name: Implement model-cost routing and ROI ledger
steps.acceptance: Each model call logs cost, lens, mission, and outcome; the ledger can report per-lens and per-model ROI and trust-score deltas.

steps.name: Build Wisdom learning loop from reality
steps.acceptance: Wisdom reads SENTRY + Receipt Auditor outcomes and updates trust_score, performs_well, performs_poorly, and disagreement_profile in the Lens Registry and product BUILD_QUEUEs.

steps.name: Unblock SMOS revenue reality loop
steps.acceptance: SMOS can send a checkout link and receive a Stripe webhook; scripts/verify-smos-live-charge.mjs and scripts/verify-smos-email-provider.mjs both report READY.

steps.name: Process a real paid transaction through SMOS
steps.acceptance: A test or real $49 payment is captured, webhook verified, and SENTRY produces a PASS receipt with separation of duties. Founder sign-off required.

steps.name: Demonstrate one full idea → blueprint → code → revenue cycle
steps.acceptance: A single product (SMOS or another) goes from FOUNDER_PACKET.md → BLUEPRINT.json → deployed code → SENTRY PASS → revenue receipt → Wisdom update, all without human design decisions after founder intent and blueprint approval.

steps.name: Final 10/10 audit and ratification
steps.acceptance: builder:preflight passes, lifeos:bp-priority:verify passes, ssot baseline met, false-done audit clean, SENTRY and Receipt Auditor operational, never-stop loop runs under hard gates, at least one product has proven revenue, and the system can run one full cycle without human rescue. Founder sign-off required.
